title: Berbere Spiced Chicken Breasts
description: This berbere spiced chicken breast recipe is Chef John’s way of using the classic Ethiopian spice blend, and it’s ready to serve in less than 30 minutes.
ingredients: 1 skinless, boneless chicken breast half - lightly pounded to an even thickness
1 tablespoon berbere spice blend, or to taste
0.25 cup chicken broth, or as needed
0.5 teaspoon berbere spice blend, or to taste

steps.text: Season both sides of chicken breast with 1 tablespoon berbere spice and 1 teaspoon kosher salt.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat until it just starts to turn brown. Add chicken breast to the skillet and cook 2 to 3 minutes per side; transfer to a warm dish.

Pour coconut milk, chicken broth, lime juice, and tomato paste into the skillet; bring to a simmer while scraping browned bits of food off the bottom of the skillet with a wooden spoon. Add 1/2 teaspoon berbere spice and pinch of salt.

Return chicken breast to the skillet; reduce heat to medium-low. Cook until chicken is cooked through and sauce starts to reduce, 4 to 5 minutes, basting chicken with pan juices as it cooks. An instant-read thermometer inserted into center should read at least 165 degrees F (74 degrees C).
Sprinkle chicken with chopped cilantro; drizzle with sauce.

video.description: Watch Chef John make a batch rich, smoky Berbere spice from scratch. Ridiculously easy to make, this intense spice is begging to be at your next backyard barbecue. A complex blend of chile powders and ground spices, Chef John uses it to make a quick, curried chicken breast. It also adds depth to lentil stew or a spicy red sauce. Better than store-bought brands, this is one of the best tasting, most versatile diy spices.
